summary: RPG 成长与战斗数值设计：带修正栈的属性、经验曲线、伤害公式、物品装备（槽位、稀有度、词缀）和任务。 Designs RPG progression and combat numbers in any engine: stats with a modifier stack, XP curves, damage formulas, items and equipment (slots, rarity, affixes) and quests. Use for a JRPG or Diablo-style looter, or stats wrong after unequipping. Pair with `save-systems` to save characters and inventory. Not for crafting and carry weight (`survival-crafting`) or dialogue (`dialogue-systems`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill rpg，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use for a JRPG or Diablo-style looter, or stats wrong after unequipping.
Workflow: Read what exists; Set pacing targets; Derive the XP table; Pick one damage family.

需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：save-systems 用 gene_gdsk_save_systems_v1，survival-crafting 用 gene_gdsk_survival_crafting_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
